rows.title: Consider removing spring-java-format-maven-plugin
rows.excerpt:
umers of the spring-perclinic sample  (i.e users who want just want to explore the example code) probably do not care for the formatting validation so its probably best not to force this on them.

If you want to keep the plugin regardless, then perhaps consider adding this extra (yuck) XML to the pom instead to disable it inside of Eclipse:

```
    <pluginManagement>
    	<plugins>
    		<!--This plugin's configuration is used to store Eclipse m2e settings only. It has no influence on the Maven build itself.-->
    		<plugin>
    			<groupId>org.eclipse.m2e</groupId>
    			<artifactId>lifecycle-mapping</artifactId>
    			<version>1.0.0</version>
    			<configuration>
    				<lifecycleMappingMetadata>
    					<pluginExecutions>
    						<pluginExecution>
    							<pluginExecutionFilter>
    								<groupId>
    									io.spring.javaformat
    								</groupId>
    								<artifactId>
    									spring-javaformat-maven-plugin
    								</artifactId>
    								<versionRange>
    									[0.0.17,)
    								</versionRange>
    								<goals>
    									<goal>validate</goal>
    								</goals>
    							</pluginExecutionFilter>
    							<action>
    								<ignore></ignore>
    							</action>
    						</pluginExecution>
    					</pluginExecutions>
    				</lifecycleMappingMetadata>
    			</configuration>
    		</plugin>
    	</plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
```

rows.title: Upgrade/java17 spring boot 3
rows.excerpt:
## Summary

This PR upgrades the application from Java 11 + Spring Boot 2.7.3 to **Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.3.6** (latest stable 3.x release). All 41 tests pass (0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skipped).

---

## Changes

### `pom.xml`

| What | Before | After | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spring-boot-starter-parent` | 2.7.3 | 3.3.6 | Latest stable SB3 |
| `java.version` | 11 | 17 | SB3 minimum; Java 11 is EOL |
| MySQL connector | `mysql:mysql-connector-java` | `com.mysql:mysql-connector-j` | Artifact relocated in SB3 BOM |
| Ehcache classifier | _(none)_ | `jakarta` | SB3 / EE 10 requires the Jakarta variant |
| New dep: `jakarta.xml.bind-api` | _(absent)_ | added | Needed for `@XmlElement`/`@XmlRootElement` on `Vet`/`Vets` |
| Git-commit-id plugin groupId | `pl.project13.maven` | `io.github.git-commit-id` | Plugin transferred to new groupId; old one fails with SB3 BOM |
| `build-info` additional properties | `${maven.compiler.source}` | `${java.version}` | `maven.compiler.source` is null in SB3 parent POM |
| JaCoCo | 0.8.7 | 0.8.11 | Java 17 bytecode support |
| spring-format | 0.0.31 | 0.0.42 | Java 17 Eclipse JDT formatter |
| nohttp-checkstyle | 0.0.10 | 0.0.11 | Compatibility |
| maven-checkstyle-plugin / Checkstyle | 3.1.2 / 8.45.1 | 3.3.1 / 10.12.4 | Java 17 source compatibility |
| Project version | 2.7.3 | 3.3.6 | Align with SB parent |

### `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties`

- Maven wrapper: **3.8.2 → 3.9.6** (recommended minimum for Spring Boot 3)

### `javax` → `jakarta` namespace migration

Spring Boot 3 moved from the Java EE `javax.*` namespace to Jakarta EE 10 `jakarta.*`. All affected files updated:
